name: What should I prepare before contacting AKN Design Group about an attached ADU project?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before contacting AKN Design Group about an attached ADU project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before contacting us for an attached ADU project, homeowners can prepare by considering their primary goals for the ADU – is it for rental income, multi-generational living, or a dedicated workspace? It's also helpful to have a general understanding of your property's layout and any specific features you envision. Having a rough idea of your desired budget range is also beneficial, as this helps us align our design solutions with your financial parameters. This initial preparation allows AKN Design Group to develop customized solutions that genuinely enhance functionality, beauty, and value, starting with a comprehensive initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before contacting us, consider your ADU's purpose, desired features, and a general budget to help us tailor design solutions.
